$comment: Configuration for the quality-check hooks in this directory. Every entry is optional and falls back to the default shown in the script that reads it; if this file is missing or malformed, skill_map is empty (skill-gate no-ops) and the other gates run on their built-in defaults. See hooks/README.md.
$comment_session_context: general_guidelines is a fixed block of engineering/style conventions injected every SessionStart, independent of whether this kit's own skills are installed. Set to false in a project's own .claude/quality-check.config.json to keep the kit's routing/checkpoint reminders but drop these.
$comment_skill_map: Ordered list. The FIRST entry whose ERE `match` hits the changed file's repo-relative path decides which SKILL.md must have been read before that file may be edited. Add project-specific rows here; remove rows for stacks the project does not use.
$comment_code_extensions: What the Stop gate counts as a code change worth reviewing. Documentation-only turns never trigger it.
$comment_checkpoint_gate: workflows are the skills whose CHECKPOINT this gate enforces - each is instructed to confirm via AskUserQuestion using this exact header before Step 3/4 may write code. Add a workflow name here only if its SKILL.md documents a CHECKPOINT the same way.
$comment_quality_gate: review_skill is the skill Claude is told to run on the diff before it may report done. max_blocks caps how many times one session may be held at the Stop gate, so a stuck loop can never trap a session.
$comment_write_lint: Cheap textual checks on freshly written content. Advisory only - real review is the review_skill's job, not a regex's.

write_lint.$comment_patterns: POSIX ERE, matched case-insensitively (grep -Ei). Keep them cheap - this hook runs after every single write.
